name: globe
title: Globe
description: A Fresnel-lit globe with rim glow, haloed atmosphere, land mesh detail, and marker layers for data storytelling.

usage.label: Astro
React
Vue
usage.code:
<script setup>
import "@/components/motion-kit/globe-element.ts";

const markers = [
  { location: [40.7128, -74.006], label: "New York" },
  { location: [51.5074, -0.1278], label: "London" },
  { location: [35.6762, 139.6503], label: "Tokyo" }
];

const fresnelConfig = {
  color: "#0F3161",
  rimColor: "#6FD3FF",
  rimPower: 12,
  rimIntensity: 0.95
};

const atmosphereConfig = {
  color: "#5AC8FA",
  scale: 1.22,
  power: 19.5,
  coefficient: 1.05,
  intensity: 0.72
};
</script>

<template>
  <motion-globe
    :radius="2.15"
    :scale="1"
    :markers="markers"
    :fresnel-config="JSON.stringify(fresnelConfig)"
    :atmosphere-config="JSON.stringify(atmosphereConfig)"
    :point-count="21500"
    :point-size="0.06"
    :auto-rotate="true"
    class="w-full h-[600px]"
  />
</template>

props.name: radius
props.description: Base radius of the globe sphere.

props.name: offset-x
props.description: Horizontal offset of the globe center.

props.name: offset-y
props.description: Vertical offset of the globe center.

props.name: fresnel-config
props.description: JSON object with color, rimColor, rimPower, and rimIntensity for the fresnel rim lighting.

props.name: atmosphere-config
props.description: JSON object with color, scale, power, coefficient, and intensity for the atmospheric glow.

props.name: point-count
props.description: Number of dots representing the land surface.

props.name: point-size
props.description: Size of individual land surface dots.

props.name: land-point-color
props.description: Color of the dots representing land masses.

props.name: locked-polar-angle
props.description: Whether to lock the polar angle (prevents flipping upside down).

props.name: markers
props.description: Array of marker objects with location [lat, lon], optional size, color, and label.

props.name: focus-on
props.description: Location [lat, lon] to smoothly rotate the globe toward.
